title: Unread Dot Per Item
description: Inside the open dropdown, each notification needs its own tiny tell for whether it's been read — a dot next to unread items only, gone once it's been acknowledged.
successCondition: Opening the notification dropdown with at least one unread and one read notification present shows an aria-label="unread" dot marker next to the unread item's title only — the read item's title renders with no such marker.
hints: Mark one notification read first (via its "Mark read" link) so you have a guaranteed read item to compare against an unread one.
The dot is a small bullet character rendered conditionally on !n.read — check its presence/absence per item, not just overall unread count.
